description: Raw delegation to the Antigravity CLI for heavy tasks that don't fit the other tools. Read-only by default; pass `write: true` to let agy edit files, `sandbox: true` to confine it. Anything it was refused comes back as a denied-actions note.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the working directory / project root. Defaults to the server's cwd.

dirs.description: Extra directories to add to agy's workspace, for cross-repo or worktree-vs-base analysis.

effort.description: Reasoning tier. Gemini models carry their tier in the name, so this switches to the sibling model at that tier (Flash (High) -> Flash (Medium)); agy's own --effort flag only reaches models without a tier. Defaults to the user's set_model choice, else the tool's own tier.

model.description: Override the model. Accepts a display name ("Gemini 3.8 Flash (High)"), an id ("gemini-3.8-flash-high"), or a family selector ("gemini-pro@latest-high"). Normally omit — the tool routes automatically.

prompt.description: The complete task prompt for agy.

sandbox.description: Run agy with terminal restrictions enabled.

schema.description: JSON Schema (as a string) constraining the answer. Returns structuredContent as well as text. Costs noticeably more latency and tokens, so use it only when you will parse the result.

slash_commands.description: Let agy expand your slash commands and skills into the prompt. Off by default: a hostile file in the workspace can otherwise steer the delegated model.

write.description: Allow file edits and command execution. Off by default.

name: delegate
